# contextforge_team (Resource)

Manages a ContextForge team resource



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Team name

### Optional

- `description` (String) Team description
- `max_members` (Number) Maximum number of members
- `slug` (String) Team slug
- `visibility` (String) Team visibility

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp (RFC3339)
- `created_by` (String) Creator email
- `id` (String) Team ID
- `is_active` (Boolean) Whether the team is active
- `is_personal` (Boolean) Whether this is a personal team
- `member_count` (Number) Current number of members
- `updated_at` (String) Last update timestamp (RFC3339)
